Hi everyone,

Thanks for the detailed feedback on the Q4 platform roadmap. I've incorporated the changes from last week's sync and attached a revised version for final review before the board meeting on the 15th.

**Summary of updates:**

1. **API deprecation timeline** — We've aligned with the platform team on a 6-month deprecation window for the legacy v1 endpoints. Migration guides will go out to all registered API consumers by end of week. The new v2 docs are already live at https://docs.company.com/api/v2.

2. **Infrastructure** — The move to the new region (eu-west-2) is still on track for December. Ops will send a maintenance window notice two weeks in advance. No client-facing downtime is expected; we'll do a blue-green cutover.

3. **Compliance** — Legal has signed off on the updated data retention section. We're good to publish the new policy page. Marketing will handle the announcement and in-app banners.

4. **Feature flags** — We're standardizing on the new feature-flag system for all Q4 launches. Each team should have their flags created in the dashboard by Friday. If you need help with rollout rules or targeting, reach out to the platform reliability team.

**Action items before the 15th:**

- Engineering: Final QA sign-off on the billing migration (staging only; prod cutover is post-board).
- Product: Confirm copy for the new onboarding flow with localization (they need strings by Wednesday).
- Legal: No open items; we're cleared.

**Board deck** — I'll circulate the updated deck by EOD Thursday. Please send any last-minute slides or talking points to me by Wednesday noon so we can merge and get a clean print run.
